libwebp 1.6.0, official source archive included. Cross build: MinGW-w64 GCC 13.2 POSIX, CMake Release, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON. Optional command-line tools disabled. webp/webpdemux/libwebpmux target OUTPUT_NAME values are webp-7__, webpdemux-2__, webpmux-3__ to match the Qt 6.4.2 plugin import names. sharpyuv is an additional runtime dependency. Public plugin import symbols are verified against these DLL export tables. Windows execution unavailable here.
